name: style_lint
description: Heuristic style checks for English and Spanish prose: possible passive voice (be + past participle; ser/estar + participio), filler words, adverbs in -ly or -mente, a word repeated within a few words, very long sentences and low variety of sentence length. Each finding has code-point offsets. Pattern matching, not grammar: review every finding.

input.text: The report was written by the committee. It was really very long.

catalog.source: original; heuristics in the spirit of plain-language style advice (Strunk and White, the US Plain Language guidelines, Fundéu); word lists written for this tool
